subject: Discovery follow-up: rotating demo slots
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: rotating demo slots

Hi Tom,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: you’re evaluating an LLM inference platform for multi-region latency and predictable cost. Key success criteria we heard: 1) consistent 200ms median token latency for customer-facing endpoints, 2) data isolation per region, and 3) cost predictability for heavy batched workloads.
- Next step: 60-minute technical deep dive + demo with our infra lead (Aditya) to go over routing policies, KV cache behavior, and a short perf playbook.

Because you have stakeholders in EU and APAC, we usually recommend a rotating meeting cadence so the same folks don’t always have to join outside normal hours. Below are three rotating time-slot proposals (all shown with local conversions for reference):

Option A (US-friendly week):
- Wed 14:00 PDT / Thu 22:00 BST / Fri 06:00 SGT
Option B (EU-friendly week):
- Thu 10:00 PDT / Thu 18:00 BST / Fri 02:00 SGT
Option C (APAC-friendly week):
- Thu 20:00 PDT / Fri 04:00 BST / Fri 12:00 SGT

If you prefer, we can do a recurring 3-week rotation: Week 1 = Option A, Week 2 = Option B, Week 3 = Option C.

Attached: mutual_action_plan_ACME_v1.pdf (draft MAP) and a small .ics with the three representative slots.

Can you confirm which option works best for you and Priya, or suggest two specific windows next week? Once you pick one, I’ll send a calendar invite and loop Aditya for the technical deep dive.

Thanks!

—
Camila
Camila Reyes | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

On a related note: I’ve added a short HubSpot deal note and attached the MAP for your review.

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@globex.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T18:22:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: rotating demo slots

Hi Camila,

Appreciate the recap and clear options. Priya and I reviewed the slots. High level: Week 2 (EU-friendly) is best for leadership alignment, but we’d like the first technical deep dive sooner if possible — ideally next week. Our availability next week (all times local):

- Tue: 09:30–11:00 BST
- Wed: 14:00–16:00 BST (better for us)
- Fri: blocked

If you can do a one-off technical session on Wed 14:00 BST that lines up with one of your proposed slots, that would be perfect. Otherwise, we’re open to the rotating schedule after the initial deep dive.

Tom
Tom Nguyen | VP of Engineering
ACME Corp
Tom.Nguyen@acme.com | +44 20 7946 0123

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: rotating demo slots

Thanks Tom,

Perfect. Wed 14:00 BST maps to Wed 06:00 PDT (my side) / Wed 22:00 SGT. Aditya can join for the tech deep dive at that time — he’s available.

I’ll schedule a one-off technical deep dive next Wednesday at the Wed 14:00 BST slot you suggested. After that, we can start the rotating 3-week cadence (A/B/C) for recurring syncs so stakeholders rotate fairly.

Tentative schedule I’ll send in the invite:
- 60 min: tech deep dive (Aditya + Camila)
- Agenda: routing policies, KV cache/latency characteristics, quantization/throughput tradeoffs, Q&A + next steps

I’ll create the invite now and attach the MAP and the .ics with the three rotation options. If Priya wants the session earlier/later that day, flag a 30-minute window and we can shift.

—
Camila
